title: VERDICT: the G-hs3-left data squeeze DEGENERATES - the face is DATA-MINIMAL (its stated support sits entirely above the measured data, and the finders cannot produce off-line witnesses at all); candidate 1 of 0122/0123 closes as a dead branch

artifacts.note: G-hs3-left section gains the VERDICT paragraph: the data-squeeze candidate degenerates in one step. Evidenced in three independent routes: (1) MECHANISM - the in-tree zero finders operate ON THE CRITICAL LINE (Riemann-Siegel / Platt record); the Platt .pd format stores per-zero 104-bit STEPS for the t-coordinate ONLY (day024_platt_fast.py decoder, verified before trust); the decoded ledgers are 8-byte float64 t-streams. No measured real part of a zero exists anywhere in the program's data. (2) ROW FORMAT - the 21-column fleet rows (day037 _point_row: FLAG, x, t, g, mnew, mcert, residf, zeta, dev, Bexp, Bph, Bz, Bdev, Btail_re, Btail_im, Bprod_re, Bprod_im, Bqrem, Bqext, nlt, flagbit) are CHANNEL/MARGIN values at TRIAL points (x, t, g, k) - the fields that look like real parts are mnew/mcert margin values, not coordinates. (3) GEOMETRY - in rh_program78_stripfront_mach_left_PT2 the face hs3LeftPT2 is STATED on t0 >= WinC.tPT2 (the verified frontier 3,000,175,332,800): below it the premise hPT2 : WinC.allOnLineUpTo q WinC.tPT2 (the cited [Z-PT2] record) eliminates off-pairs from the face's domain of application, and above it no measured data exists. The face's support is exactly the unverified territory - nothing below can be squeezed (the face is not there), and the squeeze 'audit' against measured left-flank zeros is vacuous (there are none, by mechanism and by record).
Discovery 0124 block added: candidate 1 closes as a dead branch; the G-hs3-left residual is re-pointed at its only live routes.
T4OffL block annotation extended: the face is data-minimal (0124 verdict).

why_it_matters: Closes the remaining 0121/0122/0123 data-side candidate with a three-route evidence pack (mechanism / row format / geometry) instead of leaving an open 'next' that the data cannot support. Structural lesson for the program: with the endpoint stated AT the verified frontier, every analytic face is automatically data-minimal - the face support starts where the data ends, so 'squeeze the face at measured data' is a non-command for frontier-anchored faces; the squeeze pattern (0106/0108, hWin) works only when the face extends BELOW a higher verified height, and G-hs3-left has no such extension. What remains for G-hs3-left is exactly two routes, both now unambiguous: (A) ANALYTIC - prove the full S3 squeeze at the explicitly tuned per-point schedule of T4OffL S7 (a left-flank S3 tail theory at the point (1/2 - d0, t0) with schedule n ~ (9999/2)^{1/sigma} * t^{2/sigma}) - research-level, the true residual of the program on this face; (B) MEASURED SHADOW (evidence only) - a numerical grid of the walk-vs-BwireP+MrLift inequality at left-flank trial points below 3e12 against the actual zero set: cannot shrink the machine's face (which lives above tPT2) but would be numerical encouragement for route A, and is a bounded, data-safe computation (no zero-finding, no new data - explicit functions at trial points). Route (C) frontier extension is external-record territory. No RH claim.
next: Route B first (bounded, executable, evidence): the measured left-flank shadow - for a grid of (t, d0) with t in [1e9, 3e12] bands from the existing t-ledgers and d0 in [1/200, 1/2] (log-spaced), evaluate the S3 squeeze inequality at the LEFT point (1/2 - d0 + i t) against the actual zeros in the window (the walk side) versus Z78P12.BwireP + MrLift (explicit), using the Python ports of the in-tree wire formulas (the day047/049 splice machinery already reads the .f64 t-streams). A clean shadow (margin > 0 uniformly on the grid) is a recorded numerical encouragement that route A is true, with the per-grid worst-margin pin; a violation would be the single most valuable discovery of the program (a measured counter-shape at a trial point - not a zero, but the shape of the squeeze failing) and would re-target route A. No Lean for the shadow itself; a Lean pin of the worst-margin constants follows if the shadow is clean. This is the next unit.
